messages:
Carla (partnerships): TensorPeak reached out about a joint bench story focusing on throughput-per-watt for their TP-Edge board. They want a public table + a short methods appendix. Can we scope a compact matrix to ship in ~3 weeks? @Nikhil @Sofia @Ravi thoughts? Sam, what hardware/telemetry can you provide?
Sam (TensorPeak): We can provide 2 TP-Edge nodes in our NYC lab with firmware v2.0.0, PDUs for wall-power, and an agent exposing per-chip power/temp at /metrics. Embargo: late-June preferred.
Nikhil (eng-runtime): Minimal public matrix: 3 models (redwood-open-7b, mixtral-13b, a 65b), 2 quant modes (int8, int4), and 3 batch sizes (1, 8, 16). Kernel set: stock, optimized-tiling, and tiled-GEMM. We'll capture tokens/s, p95 token latency, avg power (W), and energy-per-token.
Sofia (eng-ml): Add a small eval set for quality checks and deterministic seed. Public note should show delta-quality for int4 vs int8. We'll gate int4 if quality drop >3%.
Ravi (eng-infra): Telemetry requirements: PDU sampling at 1s, ambient temp, wall-voltage, and host trace with run_id alignment. Ingest format: JSONL per run with tags: run_id, model, quant, kernel_variant, batch_size. Alert if power variance > 15% across repeats.
Priya (marketing): For the story we need a canonical run to quote. Also want simple visuals: throughput vs watt line chart and a short methods appendix. Legal will need embargo signoff. Sam, TensorPeak ok to sign?
Sam (TensorPeak): Yes, we can sign an embargo. We'll also provide a short note on board clock/thermal profile. We prefer quoting the "sustained" 30-min run numbers.
Carla (partnerships): Proposed schedule: week 1 dry-run (7b small matrix), week 2 full runs, week 3 validation + docs + legal. Late-June embargo target. Sound good?
Nikhil (eng-runtime): Works. I'll draft a runbook and include the exact runner flags and kernel toggles. Example snippet: `./run_bench --model mixtral-13b --quant int8 --kernel tiled-gemm --batch 8 --out s3://redwood-benching/tensorpeak/tp-edge/{run_ts}/ --tags run_id=tp-edge-1960000000`
Sofia (eng-ml): I'll prepare the eval prompts and script to compute delta-ROUGE/BLEU and perplexity. Gate: if perplexity increases >2.5% on int4, we note it.
Ravi (eng-infra): I'll provision the bench ingestion bucket and an alert rule: fail run if telemetry missing >5% of samples. Also snapshot kernel counters via `tp-prof` before/after.
Bench Bot: bench-run queued: id=tp-edge-1960000000, owner=Nikhil, matrix=3models x {int8,int4} x 3batch-sizes.
Carla (partnerships): Action items: Nikhil runbook, Sofia evals, Ravi telemetry + alerts, Sam confirm lab dates and ACLs, Priya draft PR outline + embargo. I'll coordinate legal. Next sync after dry-run artifacts.
Nikhil (eng-runtime): I'll upload runbook by EOD tomorrow and include an `--energy-report` output.
Sofia (eng-ml): Eval set pushed to repo `bench/evals/tensorpeak` with seeds.
Sam (TensorPeak): Lab available next Wed (1960086400). We'll provide PDUs and the metrics agent. ACL will be sent to Ravi.
Ravi (eng-infra): Received ACL soon; will spin up ingestion and dashboards.
Priya (marketing): I'll start a draft announcement template and a short FAQ. We'll avoid any customer data.
Carla (partnerships): Great 0 thanks all. Post dry-run results here and we'll lock the embargo date after validation.
